color.$description: SEMANTIC color tokens — DARK mode (Lumen v0.4 default). Mirrors color.light.tokens.json key paths with the obsidian ramp. Glass + glow utilities are exposed as separate semantic keys for clarity.

glass.$description: Floating glass shell — pair with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%)

tint-accent.$description: Lime tint for hover / selection backgrounds

input.$description: v0.6 — input field surfaces. Aliased so theming can shift inputs without disturbing card chrome.

rest.$description: Same as surface.raised; named role for input bg.

readOnly.$description: Read-only keeps full contrast — same bg as rest. Caret hidden, content selectable.

disabled.$description: Sunken bg signals 'not interactive'. Paired with disabled border + text.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder. Alias of tertiary; carries its own role for theming.

error.$description: v0.6 — error text on the page surface. AA-safe (4.7:1) on canvas. Distinct from status.danger.fg which is the badge text on a danger background.

success.$description: v0.6 — success text. Reuses accent ramp; lime is action/live/success.

warning.$description: v0.6 — warning text. AA-safe on canvas.

frame.$description: v0.4 — brutalist hairline frame border, hairline-strong

error.$description: v0.6 — input error border. Saturated red for the hairline stroke.

success.$description: v0.6 — input success border. Lime; only after explicit validation.

disabled.$description: v0.6 — input disabled border. Muted; no hover/focus.

fg.$description: Obsidian-leaning #0a0a0d on lime — 12.6:1 AAA. Never inherit text-primary.

tertiary.$description: v0.9 alias of ghost — kept for backwards compatibility. New code uses ghost surface composed with neutral intent.

ghost.$description: v0.9 — no chrome at rest, subtle hover tint. The neutral × ghost surface.

outline.$description: v0.9 — hairline pill (transparent fill, 1px border). The neutral × outline surface. Mirrors current secondary visually but is keyword-explicit for orthogonal composition.

danger.$description: v0.9 — bg deepened red.500→.700 to clear WCAG AA Normal (4.5:1). Was 3.94:1 with red.500/white per visual audit.

rest.$description: v0.9 — was {color.status.danger.500} (3.94:1 AA fail). Now red.700 #c92626 (~5.2:1 AA pass).

hover.$description: v0.9 — was .700; now .800 for stronger hover delta.

press.$description: v0.9 — added for press feedback (was missing).

danger-soft.$description: v0.9 — danger × ghost surface. Carbon's `danger-ghost` pattern. For destructive actions in tight contexts (table row delete, settings) where solid red would over-emphasize.

fg.$description: Lumen text.error — same source. 4.7:1 on canvas.

ai.$description: v0.9 — AI-action variant. Lime tonal surface + sparkle leading icon. Sparingly: only on AI-driven primary actions (Improve, Summarize, Suggest, Quote-with-AI). Not a general-purpose intent. See ADR 0016.

fg.$description: Laser lime — brighter than accent.fg on tonal lime to maintain perceived hierarchy.

success.$description: v0.9 — success-affirmation feedback variant. Same lime palette as primary per the single-accent rule, but tonal not solid. Used briefly (1.6 s) post-success state of any button (`<Button success>Saved</Button>`).

selected.$description: v0.9 — aria-pressed=true state for ToggleButton / Segmented option. Subtle lime tint + lime hairline. Distinct from primary (filled lime).

glass.$description: v0.9 — translucent surface for floating overlays (toolbar pinned over a map, modal action bar, scrim toolbar). Composes with backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Not a default primary.

aurora.$description: Radial lime ambient glow — the brand's signature lighting gesture. Render as a fixed/absolute pseudo-element behind the page hero with backdrop-filter: blur and the values below.
